protocol.physical_parameters: Unchanged control.execute and dispatch.settlement; original official input hashes preserved
protocol.incumbent: Accepted legacy two-midnight M0 with the same true final6000; fixed48 is separately retained as the single-factor horizon reference.
protocol.selection: Staged one-factor January comparisons, equal weight to each question relative to its stage reference. Within0.1percent select the listed simpler configuration. No annual cost enters parameter selection.
protocol.predictor_selection: Keep accepted historical forecast families. Select official PV fusion/correction by Jan15-24 next-six-hour MAE; retrospective development scores are not claimed to be unbiased held-out forecasts.
protocol.grid_selection: Smallest grid whose January total bills in all four questions are within0.02percent of641; not the grid yielding minimum expense.
protocol.M1_development_gate: Mean normalized saving at least0.1percent, no question worse than0.1percent, positive aggregate saving in both Jan25-27 and Jan28-31.
protocol.annual_adoption_gate: One January-selected challenger only: normalized mean saving>=0.1percent, no question worse, positive aggregate saving in both Feb-Jun and Jul-Dec, and lower endpoint of paired7day block bootstrap total saving>0. If not met retain the frozen incumbent.0.1-0.3percent requires the predeclared state/conditional-probability theoretical role;>=0.3percent may justify adoption. No selecting a different annual winner.

bootstrap.interpretation: paired moving-block stability diagnostic on one seasonal year, not a distribution-free future-year confidence guarantee

protocol.gain_expansion_rule: If over5percent of active gains hit the bound in January, move to the next predeclared bound5/10/20 regardless of bill. If20 remains above5percent, add40 and80 sequentially as declared engineering checks; freeze before annual. Formal hits do not trigger expense-based retuning.
protocol.tail_interface: Fixed-H zero/linear are inventory-tail truncation heuristics with explicit causal q suffix completion. Existing SDDP compared with zero/linear/scaled tails in a separate common two-midnight block. No inventory-only SDDP at nonmidnight; no unimplemented contract bridge claimed.
protocol.horizon_pool: Each H uses all its own complete mature blocks, identical generator settings; thus H changes legally available history too. Report requested/effective counts rather than claiming an isolated physical-lookahead effect.
protocol.scope: All economic development configurations are registered for334days; forecast-only MAE fits are not unexecuted closed-loop policy results. Free-end sensitivity is separate.
